items.title: Trimble’s (NASDAQ:TRMB) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue, Full-Year Outlook Slightly Exceeds Expectations
items.summary: Geospatial technology provider Trimble (NASDAQ:TRMB) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 11% year on year to $972 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $965.5 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was 7.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
